summary: A stark black/white slide-per-screen page for a typeface designed to be read by touch: a 'Form Follows Touch' slogan, hover-zone style switchers (pointer position picks weight, slant or alternates), a measured KÖ/ait diagram and black-and-white photos and GIFs of hands tracing letters. A fixed top-left Try/Buy pair and a circle toggle site-wide alternates. The final links slide (Live Typetester, trials, PDF, minisite buttons) exists in the DOM and the mobile capture but was not segmented into a block.

instances.look: Two-screen black slide: 'FORM / FOLLOWS / TOUCH' in big white caps with 'GT HAPTIK' below, three short centred intro paragraphs, and a line-drawn 'YO' flag pictogram; tiny grey 'Try the free trial fonts / Buy the printed specimen' and a small circle pinned top-left
instances.ux: Fixed top-left links (Try → trials, Buy → printed specimen shop) collapse to 'Try / Buy' after the hero; clicking the fixed circle turns on alternates for R, C, G and 0 across the whole page (copy says so); a hand-gesture photo flashes as a loader before the slogan
instances.learn: Rewrite a design maxim around the font's purpose ('Form follows touch') and let the slogan be the specimen

reconstruction.layout: Slide 1440×1800 (2 viewports) black; slogan centred, 3 lines, top at y≈160, ~760px wide; 'GT HAPTIK' ~60px below; intro text column ~700px centred at y≈830; flag pictogram ~300px centred at y≈1220; fixed corner UI at x≈30, y≈30
reconstruction.typography: Slogan uppercase GT Haptik Medium, rendered cap height ~110px (≈150px; computed font-size 72px, apparently scaled), tight leading ~1.05; name ~60px caps Medium; intro ~22px GT Haptik Regular, centred, leading ~1.35; corner links ~13px grey
reconstruction.behaviour: Loader frame: black-and-white photo of two hands making signs (~1s) before the slide; alternates toggle swaps glyph forms site-wide (class switch); no scroll animation
reconstruction.content: Real description: 'Its uppercase letters and numbers were optimized to be read blindfolded and by touching them' plus style count and alternates note
reconstruction.assets: Line pictogram of a 'YO' flag (background image); hand photo loader

instances.look: White screen with 'Monolinear / Geometric' in black at ~250px, filling the width
instances.ux: Seven invisible vertical zones across the screen (Lazer, Thin, Light, Regular, Medium, Bold, Black); the pointer's x position sets the weight of both words and a dot with the style name marks the current zone; on mobile, touch instead and four extra words appear (Dreieck, Research, Touchable, Solution)
instances.learn: Map the weight ladder onto the screen width: sweeping the pointer left to right is the whole weight demo, with no visible control

reconstruction.behaviour: mouseenter on a .stylechooser zone → swap the sample's font-family to that weight and show its dot and label

instances.look: Two-screen black slide with seven centred lines 'GT Haptik Lazer' … 'GT Haptik Black', each in its own weight (Lazer a hairline, nearly invisible)

instances.learn: Use the same hover-zone trick for slant: the visitor compares oblique and rotalic on the full weight ladder by moving the pointer
